fine_lines.title: advice vs advise
fine_lines.explanation_ar: advice اسم غير معدود (نصيحة): some advice، a piece of advice. advise فعل (ينصح). النطق مختلف: advice تنتهي بصوت /s/، و advise بصوت /z/.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'Advice' is an uncountable noun. 'Advise' is the verb. Advice ends in /s/, advise ends in /z/.

examples.sentence: Anna gave Denise some good advice.
I advise you to register with an agency.

fine_lines.title: sign up for vs register with
fine_lines.explanation_ar: المعنى متقارب: التسجيل. نقول sign up for + خدمة أو نشاط (موقع، دورة)، و register with + جهة أو شركة (وكالة، طبيب).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both mean join officially. 'Sign up for' an activity or service; 'register with' an organisation.

examples.sentence: Sign up for a job website.

expressions.meaning_en: Try to see the good side.
expressions.example: Don't worry about the interview. You need to think positively.

expressions.phrase: Try looking in the job section of the newspaper.
expressions.meaning_ar: جرّب البحث في قسم الوظائف في الصحيفة.
expressions.meaning_en: A suggestion: look at job adverts in the paper.
expressions.example: Try looking in the job section of the local newspaper.

expressions.phrase: There are loads of job-finding websites you could sign up for.
expressions.meaning_ar: هناك الكثير من مواقع البحث عن العمل التي يمكنك التسجيل فيها.
expressions.meaning_en: Many websites can help you find a job.
expressions.example: There are loads of websites you could sign up for.

expressions.phrase: What about ringing some of the people you know?
expressions.meaning_ar: ما رأيك في الاتصال ببعض معارفك؟
expressions.meaning_en: A suggestion: phone people you know.
expressions.example: What about ringing your old manager?

expressions.phrase: You could register with a recruitment agency.
expressions.meaning_en: A suggestion: join a job agency.
expressions.example: You could register with a recruitment agency in the city.

expressions.meaning_en: We're sad that you are leaving.

expressions.phrase: We wish you very well in the future.
expressions.meaning_ar: نتمنى لك كل التوفيق في المستقبل.
expressions.example: Thank you for your hard work. We wish you very well in the future.

expressions.phrase: Thank you for all your hard work.
expressions.meaning_en: A formal thank you to someone who worked well.
expressions.example: Thank you for all your hard work this year.

grammar.title: Ways of giving advice and suggestions
grammar.explanation_ar: هناك عدة صيغ لتقديم النصيحة: You need to + فعل (قوية)، Try + فعل بـ ing (جرّب)، You could + فعل (اقتراح لطيف)، What about + فعل بـ ing? (ما رأيك في...)، Have you tried + ing? (هل جربت...).
grammar.explanation_en: Ways to advise: You need to + verb (strong); Try + -ing; You could + verb (gentle); What about + -ing?; Have you tried + -ing?
examples: Try looking in the job section.
You could register with a recruitment agency.
What about ringing some of the people you know?
Have you tried looking in the newspaper?

grammar.title: There are + plural noun + (that) you could...
grammar.explanation_ar: There are loads of websites you could sign up for: الجملة بعد الاسم تصفه دون الحاجة إلى that، وتبقى حروف الجر في النهاية (for).
grammar.explanation_en: A relative clause can follow the noun without 'that'; the preposition stays at the end.
examples: There are loads of websites you could sign up for.
Here's a list of agencies you can register with.
He's the person I work for.
